result.title: FiReIQ: Field-Level Confidence Estimation with Reasoning and Image Quality in Document Extraction
result.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in structured document extraction, yet their deployment in high-stakes applications requires reliable confidence estimates for individual fields. Existing uncertainty estimators often aggregate signals across an entire generation, obscuring field-specific reasoning uncertainty while overlooking visual degradations that may lead to confident extraction errors. To address these limitations, we introduce FiReIQ, a field-level confidence estimation framework that combines field-aligned reasoning signals from a single VLM generation with local and global image-quality features through quality-conditioned visual fusion. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we further introduce FiReIQ-Bench, a benchmark spanning financial receipts and legal contracts. Experiments with two reasoning VLMs show that FiReIQ consistently improves confidence discrimination, selective prediction, and probabilistic accuracy over existing estimators. These gains extend to private financial service data, where FiReIQ improves AUROC by 6.8% and coverage at 95% precision by 10.6% over an existing baseline. Together, these results highlight the potential of FiReIQ to reduce manual review while enabling more reliable document automation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FiReIQ，从单次 VLM 生成中抽取与字段对齐的推理信号，并以质量条件化的视觉融合结合局部与全局图像质量特征，进行字段级置信度估计；同时构建覆盖财务收据与法律合同的 FiReIQ-Bench，评测置信度区分度与选择性预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 评价侧的停止／弃权决策及「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」问题相关，其字段级推理信号与图像质量门控可供核查能否用于诊断高置信误判与视觉旁路，但方法本身不涉及内部 latent 状态。
